definitions.explanation: To run in various directions, typically with high energy, often used for children or animals.

definitions.gloss: to rush about, to run around busily
definitions.explanation: To be very busy running from place to place to get things done.

notes:
{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る is an intransitive verb (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧) meaning to run around.

ETYMOLOGY:
- ⟦{走|はし}る→走る：00519_hashiru⟧ (to run) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around) → to run around

ASPECT (ている):
{走|はし}り{回|まわ}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ indicates an ongoing action of running around, often with energy.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る (run around energetically)
- ⟦あちこち→あちこち：01687_achikochi⟧{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る (run around everywhere)
- ⟦{忙|いそが}しく→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る (run around busily)

USAGE:
Often used for children playing or animals being active. Also used figuratively to describe being very busy and having to go to many places.
